types.name: AICharacterPedestrian

fields.name: pedIndex
fields.comment: high: UpdateClosestPed 23ce0 skips fpPeds[i] (0x1dde98, count fgNumPeds 0x1dded8) when i == [ESI+0x140]; KillSelf/Recycle/HandleInterrupts/FindPointAgainstWall read; PS2 +0x150 (SetBuddy hint). Name invented

fields.name: worldPos
fields.comment: medium: PreventFalling passes it as this to WWorldPos::FindClosestFace on both builds; PS2 +0x154. Name invented

fields.name: collider
fields.comment: medium: ~AICharacterPedestrian/FindPointAgainstWall; WCollider::~WCollider hint on both builds (PS2 +0x158); the same hint on EnemyGround was doubtful (cluster7), so check before trusting the type

fields.name: prevState
fields.comment: medium: DoWalking 270b0/DoStartled 27150/KillSelf store the old [+0x5c] state here just before writing a new one; PS2 +0x15c written by SetNewState. Name invented

fields.name: pedFlags
fields.comment: medium: byte bit tests: DoWalking TEST [+0x150],3, DoStartled TEST 2, KillSelf TEST 1 and clears it; PS2 +0x160 1-byte (a char on both builds, not a packed bool, so no shift). Name invented

fields.name: unknown151
fields.comment: low: not seen on Xbox; PS2 +0x161 1-byte R/W in DoDodging, next to pedFlags

fields.name: buddyIndex
fields.comment: medium: KillSelf 24140 indexes the ped table with [ESI+0x154], resets the buddy's +0x14c/+0x150/+0x154/+0x19c, then overwrites this field; PS2 +0x164 (SetBuddy(int,int)). Name invented

fields.name: unknown158
fields.comment: low: no Xbox access seen; PS2 +0x168 R/W in Recycle (uniform -0x10 shift)

fields.name: currentAnim
fields.comment: medium: PlayAnim/DoDying/DoNeutral read; PS2 +0x16c passed to PlayAnim/PlayCrossFade. Name invented

fields.name: closestPed
fields.comment: high: UpdateClosestPed 23ce0 stores the index it returns (-1 if none); PS2 +0x170

fields.name: closestPedDist
fields.comment: high: UpdateClosestPed stores the best distance (init 9999.9 = 0x461c3f9a); PS2 +0x174 float

fields.name: prevClosestPed
fields.comment: high: UpdateClosestPed copies +0x160 here first; PS2 +0x178

fields.name: prevClosestPedDist
fields.comment: high: UpdateClosestPed copies +0x164 here first; PS2 +0x17c float

fields.name: fleeTarget
fields.comment: medium: DoStartled 27150 passes LEA [ESI+0x170] to SetTarget 23ba0 (missed by the scanner); PS2 +0x180 LEA in DoAvoiding/DoDodging/DoLeaning/DoStartled/Recycle. Name invented

fields.name: nextTarget
fields.comment: medium: DoWalking 270b0 copies +0x180..+0x188 into target +0x190; PS2 +0x190 written by Recycle. Name invented

fields.name: target
fields.comment: high: SetTarget(COORD3 &) / FaceTarget / ReachedTarget; FaceTarget writes +0x198 float; PS2 SetTarget +0x1a0..+0x1a8

fields.name: stateTimer
fields.comment: low: zeroed by DoWalking/DoStartled/KillSelf/HandleInterrupts on every state change; PS2 +0x1ac (SetNewState, DoAvoiding). Name invented

fields.name: unknown1a0
fields.comment: low: PlayAnim writes; PS2 +0x1b0 PlayAnim/PlayCrossFade/DoAvoiding/DoDodging

fields.name: unknown1a4
fields.comment: low: UpdateRotPos/UpdateThreatRelativeDirection write float; PS2 +0x1b4

fields.name: unknown1a8
fields.comment: low: UpdateRotPos writes float; PS2 +0x1b8

fields.name: unknown1ac
fields.comment: low: KillSelf zeroes, HandleInterrupts/ThreatenedByVehicle write float; PS2 +0x1bc float

fields.name: unknown1b0
fields.comment: low: KillSelf zeroes, HandleInterrupts writes; PS2 +0x1c0 float (KillSelf)

fields.name: active
fields.comment: medium: UpdateClosestPed only considers other peds whose byte +0x1b4 is set; MaintainHeading reads; PS2 +0x1c4 4-byte (next field keeps the -0x10 shift, so padded). Name invented

fields.name: roadSegment
fields.comment: low: UpdateClosestPed compares other peds' +0x1b8 with its own (match or -1); KillSelf/MaintainHeading write; PS2 +0x1c8. Name invented (cf. fgLastSeg)

fields.name: unknown1bc
fields.comment: low: UpdateThreatRelativeDirection reads; PS2 +0x1cc

fields.name: walkNav
fields.comment: medium: MaintainHeading reads; PS2 +0x1d0 passed to WRoadNav::IncNavPosition, returned by GetWalkToNav. Name invented

fields.name: animController
fields.comment: medium: AnimationController * (PS2 +0x1d4 passed to AnimationController::GetCurrentFrame); PlayAnim writes. Type void * (size unknown), name invented

fields.name: animSpeed
fields.comment: low: PlayAnim/UpdateAnimSpeed write float; PS2 +0x1d8 float. Name invented

fields.name: unknown1cc
fields.comment: low: UpdateAnimSpeed writes; PS2 +0x1dc float

fields.name: unknown1d0
fields.comment: low: LEA in DoLeaning/FindPointAgainstWall; PS2 +0x1e0 (w8 + w4) written by FindPointAgainstWall

fields.name: wallPoint
fields.comment: low: FindPointAgainstWall LEA +0x1e0 and writes +0x1e4/+0x1e8; PS2 +0x1f0..+0x1f8 floats (DoLeaning, FindPointAgainstWall). Name invented

fields.name: unknown1ec
fields.comment: low: DoLeaning writes; PS2 +0x1fc

fields.name: unknown1f0
fields.comment: low: ThreatenedByVehicle writes; PS2 +0x200

fields.name: unknown1f4
fields.comment: low: ThreatenedByVehicle R/W; PS2 +0x204 (also Recycle)

fields.name: unknown1f8
fields.comment: low: ThreatenedByVehicle R/W; PS2 +0x208

fields.name: unknown1fc
fields.comment: low: ThreatenedByVehicle/UpdateAnimSpeed R/W; PS2 +0x20c (DoTurning, Recycle)

fields.name: unknown200
fields.comment: low: not seen on Xbox; PS2 +0x210 R/W in CheckVehicleThreat/DoDodging

fields.name: unknown204
fields.comment: low: CheckVehicleThreat LEA; PS2 +0x214 LEA float

fields.name: threatSide
fields.comment: low: DoStartled compares float +0x208 with a constant to pick a -/+0.25 lean; CheckVehicleThreat LEA; PS2 +0x218 LEA float. Name invented

fields.name: unknown20c
fields.comment: low: CheckVehicleThreat/DoDodging/ThreatenedByVehicle/UpdateAnimSpeed float; PS2 +0x21c

fields.name: threatPos0
fields.comment: low: LEA in CheckVehicleThreat/DoDodging/SetNewTargetBasedOnThreat; PS2 +0x220 (w8 + w4). 16-byte stride to the next vector on both builds, +0x21c unaccessed. Name invented

fields.name: threatPos1
fields.comment: low: as threatPos0; PS2 +0x230..+0x238 floats

fields.name: threatPos2
fields.comment: low: LEA in CheckVehicleThreat/SetNewTargetBasedOnThreat; PS2 +0x240 (w8 + w4)

fields.name: unknown23c
fields.comment: low: ThreatenedByVehicle writes; PS2 +0x24c float (DoDodging too)

fields.name: unknown240
fields.comment: low: FindPointAgainstWall R/W; PS2 +0x250

fields.name: unknown244
fields.comment: low: FindPointAgainstWall R/W; PS2 +0x254

fields.name: unknown248
fields.comment: low: FindPointAgainstWall writes float; PS2 +0x258 float

fields.name: unknown24c
fields.comment: low: DoStartled writes -1; DoDodging/DoLeaning write; PS2 +0x25c

fields.name: useAimTarget
fields.comment: medium: TargetIsInRange 24b30 uses COORD3 +0x260 when this byte is set, else Bond's rigid-body position; DoAiming R/W; PS2 +0x260 1-byte. Name invented

fields.name: aimTarget
fields.comment: medium: TargetIsInRange LEA +0x260; PS2 +0x270 (w8 + w4) in HandleInterrupts/Recycle/TargetIsInRange. Name invented

fields.name: unknown26c
fields.comment: low: DoAiming R/W; PS2 +0x27c

fields.name: unknown270
fields.comment: low: DoAiming R/W; PS2 +0x280

fields.name: targetAngle
fields.comment: medium: TargetIsInRange stores the wrapped angle between facing and target; DoAiming writes; PS2 +0x284 float (same role as EnemySnow +0x154). Name invented

fields.name: aimYaw
fields.comment: low: DoAiming R/W float; PS2 +0x288; by analogy with EnemySnow +0x158. Name invented

fields.name: unknown27c
fields.comment: low: DoAiming R/W float; PS2 +0x28c LEA float (address taken: maybe the start of a float[2] as in EnemySnow +0x160)

fields.name: unknown280
fields.comment: low: DoAiming writes float; PS2 +0x290 LEA float

types.comment: Pooled pedestrian (fpPeds 0x1dde98, 16 slots); size 0x290 from deleting destructor 24700 FastFree (PS2 probably 0x2a0). Own fields uniformly PS2 -0x10 (PS2 +0x150..+0x290 -> Xbox +0x140..+0x280); the chars at +0x150/+0x151 and bools at +0x1b4/+0x250 cause no further shift.

types.name: AICharacterEnemySnow

fields.name: vehicle
fields.comment: high: ctor 1fd40 stores arg3 (ctor(MATRIX4 &, int, PVehicle *)); DoNeutral makes vtable calls on it; PhysicsObject::GetHitPoints hint; PS2 +0x150 (GetVehiclePtr)

fields.name: leanDirection
fields.comment: low: ctor 0; DoNeutral writes 0 or 1 together with subState 0x15; DoLeaning reads; PS2 +0x154. Name invented

fields.name: aimPitchDir
fields.comment: low: ctor 0; DoAiming XORs it with base +0x94 to choose the +/- step for aimPitch; PS2 +0x158. Name invented

fields.name: aimTimer
fields.comment: medium: ctor 0; DoAiming increments it, compares with +0x150, resets; PS2 +0x15c. Name invented

fields.name: aimTimerLimit
fields.comment: medium: ctor 0; DoAiming sets (random*0xb4)>>16 (0..180); PS2 +0x160. Name invented

fields.name: targetAngle
fields.comment: medium: ctor 0; TargetIsInRange 20710 stores an angle (FST); DoAiming scales it; PS2 +0x164 float. Name invented

fields.name: aimYaw
fields.comment: medium: ctor 0; DoAiming steps toward targetAngle, clamps to +/-90 (0x42b40000), passes to 0x114c60 (rotation builder); PS2 +0x168. Name invented

fields.name: aimPitch
fields.comment: medium: ctor 0; DoAiming steps it, clamps to -70/+120; PS2 +0x16c. Name invented

fields.name: blendWeights
fields.comment: medium: ctor zero loop; DoAiming loop i<2: [+0x160+4i] += [+0x168+4i], clamp 0..1, passes &+0x160 to 0x11780 (actor blend); PS2 +0x170 LEA. Name invented

fields.name: blendRates
fields.comment: medium: added to blendWeights each frame, zeroed when clamped; DoAiming/DoArmed/DoNeutral/PlayZoneInjuryAnim write; PS2 +0x178 LEA/W, +0x17c. Name invented

types.comment: Snowmobile-riding enemy (ctor(MATRIX4 &, int weapon, PVehicle *), sets injuryZones 0x1b51d8); size 0x170 from dtor 1fdd0. Own fields uniformly PS2 -0x10.

types.name: AICharacterEnemySunroof

fields.name: vehicle
fields.comment: high: ctor 210f0 stores arg4 and reads its word +0x4a (rigid body index) for Simulation::GetRigidBody; PhysicsObject::GetHitPoints hint; PS2 +0x150 (GetVehiclePtr)

fields.name: lastVehicleVelocity
fields.comment: medium: ctor copies GetRigidBody(vehicle)->velocity (+0x20) here; PS2 +0x160 (w8 + w4) written by ctor and DoTilting (VehicleIsAccelerating compares). Name invented

fields.name: unknown15c
fields.comment: low: ctor 0; DoArmed/DoLeaning R/W; PS2 +0x16c also in VehicleIsAccelerating

fields.name: partnerA
fields.comment: medium: ctor 0; TargetIsInRange 218f0 dereferences [+0x160]+0xa8 (actor iterator) ->+8 ->byte +0x24, as for an AICharacter; DoInitial writes; PS2 +0x170. Name invented

fields.name: partnerB
fields.comment: medium: same pattern as +0x160; PS2 +0x174. Name invented

fields.name: targetable
fields.comment: high: ctor FastAlloc(0x50) then WTargetable ctor 0xcd9b0(this) and stores it; ~AICharacterEnemySunroof/DoDying call WTargetable::RemoveReference; PS2 +0x178 (its ~AICharacter hint is a folded dtor)

types.comment: Enemy in a car sunroof (ctor(MATRIX4 &, int weapon, int, PVehicle *), owns a WTargetable); size 0x170 from dtor 21230. Own fields uniformly PS2 -0x10; +0x144..+0x14f unaccessed on both builds.
